reference: Own DSTS chr042 FunBeemon model and native clips. PMDO registry supplies action names, timing fields and events.
flight_policy: Retain native wingbeats, bob and vertical arcs above the fixed row-50 ground shadow. No per-frame contact correction.
eye_policy: Keep source eye meshes, pale eye whites, green iris and native dark contour; inspect at 29px. No painted pupil or speculative eyelid.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward flight and alternating wingbeat; loop endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native head and forelimb lunge while airborne.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native upright release gesture; no effect or projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native resting flight and lowered forelimbs. Eye closure must be judged at native scale.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil and disrupted wing motion.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward abdomen and forelimb sweep.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two cycles of the native strike; PMDO XML has one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native rise and arc while already flying; no forced landing.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native forelimb strain with reverse-sampled recovery; no invented energy effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native flight Idle wingbeat and explicit whole-view yaw; source fq01 travels outside a stable sprite canvas.
